title: Summit Upgrade Certificate and Miles Upgrade Costs
content:
Upgrades paid with Summit Upgrade Certificates or with miles in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program cost the following, by the member's tier.

| Tier | Certificates per domestic or short-haul international segment | Certificates per long-haul international segment | Certificate validity (calendar months after issue) | Miles per segment, segments up to the ticket's segment length threshold | Miles per segment, longer segments | Cash co-pay per segment, miles upgrade (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 1 | 2 | 12 | 15000 | 25000 | 75 |
| Summit Silver | 1 | 2 | 12 | 15000 | 25000 | 75 |
| Summit Gold | 1 | 2 | 12 | 15000 | 25000 | 75 |
| Summit Platinum | 1 | 2 | 12 | 15000 | 25000 | 50 |
| Summit Diamond | 1 | 2 | 12 | 15000 | 25000 | 0 |
| Summit Chairman | 1 | 2 | 12 | 15000 | 25000 | 0 |

The segment length threshold that separates the two miles columns is the one the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter sets for the ticket concerned.

**Hypothetical readings**

- A long-haul international segment upgraded by certificate uses 2 certificates at every tier; a domestic segment uses 1.
- A segment longer than the ticket's threshold upgraded with miles costs 25000 miles at every tier; the cash co-pay listed for that tier is 75 USD at Summit Gold and 50 USD at Summit Platinum.
- A certificate issued on 10 March of a year stays valid for 12 calendar months after that issue.
